{{Quote|You must be Anakin Skywalker. I am Jeter Snahl. Master Yoda sent word that I should expect a visitor. But tell me, what brings you to Bunduki?|Jeter Snahl, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="WotW" />}}
'''Jeter Snahl''' was a member of the [[Followers of Palawa]]. A hermit, Snahl resided on [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]], where he guarded the secrets of the [[Way of the Warrior]].<ref name="WotW" />
